note: Set B is better because it correctly extracts significantly more information from the Finish Schedule (QZ, P1, P2) and Furniture Schedule (F1, F7, F10) that Set A misses entirely. While both sets share similar errors in Millwork tag bindings (e.g., MWK05 type) and Furniture tag swaps (F4/F5/F6), Set B provides a more complete and accurate representation of the document's data overall, particularly for finishes and furniture quantities/dimensions where it is correct.
